best_idea: A world-state ledger of named boolean flags (one byte each, page-grown, capped, compacted on save) whose set-to-true write is the one place that also writes a journal line, once per flag.
decision_why: Keep the flag ledger, the single setter with journal-on-set, and the answer list with push/pop; key flags by data names and answers by id; reject the SI-only special case and the unguarded pop.
acceptance: A server test: setting the quest flag met_smith to true adds one journal line, and setting it again adds none; after save and reload the flag and the journal line are unchanged; a client message that tries to set a flag is refused. A client check: the choice list shows keys 1-9 then a-z, and ESC picks the bye answer when one exists and does nothing when there is none.
